answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 31946 Country: India Title: I get lot of sex thoughts ,sometimes iam lost thinking in them,was this haram??? Question: I get lot of sex thoughts ,sometimes iam lost thinking in them,was this haram??? i wanted to keep fast to control it,my parents told iam too young for such things???iam internally angry at them??? some people go for jamaat for 1 yr ,arent they cutting family ties?? Answer ID: 31946 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 912/595/H=1432) (1) Instead of being angry with your parents, you should keep on controlling your thought. Its method is that you should recite the holy Quran and durood extensively. You should study: (a) Fazail Sadaqat, (b) Hayatul Muslimin as much as you can. (2) What do you mean by family ties? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
